items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And that place, they was had Harry the Hipster in there.

ctx.x: Oh, Lord yes. And that was some rhythm we had going. He and Tiny Brown, the bass player, Slim Gaillard and myself. Boy and we'd get gigs to play down at the May Company during lunch hour and all that kind of stuff, you know.
And that place, they was had Harry the Hipster in there.
